scripts.source:
import sys, subprocess, pathlib, json, datetime, os
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
evidence=root/'docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-post-merge-hook'
evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
name=sys.argv[1]
command=sys.argv[2:]
start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
log=evidence/(name+'.log')
with log.open('w') as out:
    result=subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
receipt=dict(name=name,command=command,startedAt=start,finishedAt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),exitCode=result.returncode,log=str(log.relative_to(root)))
with (evidence/'command-receipts.jsonl').open('a') as out:
    out.write(json.dumps(receipt)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)
lines=log.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
print('\n'.join(lines[-30:] if result.returncode else lines[-8:]),flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode if result.returncode>=0 else 128-result.returncode)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,os,shutil,time,errno,sys
root=Path.cwd(); evidence=root/'docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-post-merge-hook'
name=sys.argv[1]
original_entries=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--stage','-z'])
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only']).strip()
test_index=root/'_scratch/post-merge-hook/replay.index'
env=dict(os.environ,GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(test_index),AIO_TEST_NO_CACHE='1',AIO_TEST_MAX_FORKS='2')
subprocess.run(['git','read-tree','HEAD'],env=env,check=True)
for file in ['src/main/core/system/provider-quota-service.ts','src/main/core/system/provider-quota-service.spec.ts']:
    blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','main:'+file],text=True).strip()
    subprocess.run(['git','update-index','--cacheinfo','100644',blob,file],env=env,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','scripts/run-git-hook.js','scripts/__tests__/run-git-hook.spec.ts','src/main/orchestration/default-loop-native-finality.spec.ts'],env=env,check=True)
selected=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],env=env,text=True).splitlines()
assert len(selected)==5,selected
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        if (root/'dist').exists():shutil.rmtree(root/'dist')
        break
    except OSError as e:
        if e.errno!=errno.ENOTEMPTY or attempt==2:raise
        time.sleep(.2)
assert not (root/'dist').exists()
try:
    result=subprocess.run(['rtk','proxy','python3','_scratch/post-merge-hook/run.py',name,'rtk','proxy','sh','.githooks/pre-commit'],env=env)
finally:
    after=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--stage','-z'])
    (evidence/(name+'-index.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(selectedPaths=selected,workerCap=2,distAbsentAtStart=True,beforeEntriesSha256=hashlib.sha256(original_entries).hexdigest(),afterEntriesSha256=hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest(),realStagedEntriesUnchanged=original_entries==after,realStagedPaths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()),indent=2)+'\n')
    test_index.unlink(missing_ok=True)
assert original_entries==after
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

from pathlib import Path
import datetime, errno, gzip, hashlib, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, time
root=Path.cwd()
e=root/'docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_evidence/2026-10-27-post-merge-hook'
report=Path('/Users/suas/work/orchestrat0r/ai-orchestrator/docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_livetest.md')
def now(): return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def digest(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def command(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['rtk','proxy',*args],text=True)
def remove(p):
    for attempt in range(3):
        try: shutil.rmtree(p); return
        except OSError as error:
            if error.errno!=errno.ENOTEMPTY or attempt==2: raise
            time.sleep(.2)
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (e/'command-receipts.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
required=['pre-commit-final','dependency-compatibility-final','pinned-typecheck-renderer','pinned-typecheck-spec','pinned-lint','pinned-check-ts-max-loc','pinned-check-ui-hints','pinned-build-main','pinned-build-renderer','full-suite-pinned']
for name in required:
    matches=[r for r in rows if r['name']==name]
    assert matches and matches[-1]['exitCode']==0,name
assert 'VERDICT: PASS' in (e/'independent-review.txt').read_text()
source_hashes=json.loads((e/'reviewed-source-hashes.json').read_text())
for name,value in source_hashes.items(): assert digest(root/name)==value,name
assert not command('git','diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
assert command('git','branch','--show-current').strip()=='queue/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resili-493f81'
final_log=(e/'full-suite-pinned.log').read_text()
pid=re.findall(r'_scratch/test-run\.pid-(\d+)\.log',final_log)[-1]
data=json.loads((root/f'_scratch/test-results.pid-{pid}.json').read_text())
assert data['success'] and data['numFailedTests']==0 and data['numFailedTestSuites']==0
summary={k:data.get(k) for k in ['success','numTotalTestSuites','numPassedTestSuites','numFailedTestSuites','numTotalTests','numPassedTests','numFailedTests','numPendingTests','numTodoTests']}
(e/'full-suite-pinned-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
patterns=[r'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----',r'\bsk-(?:proj-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,}',r'\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{24,}',r'\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{20,}',r'\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}']
owned_pids=set()
for p in e.glob('*.log'):
    owned_pids.update(re.findall(r'_scratch/test-run\.pid-(\d+)\.log',p.read_text(errors='replace')))
raw=e/'raw-test-receipts';raw.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
receipts=[]
for task_pid in sorted(owned_pids):
    for stem,suffix in [('test-run','.log'),('test-results','.json')]:
        p=root/f'_scratch/{stem}.pid-{task_pid}{suffix}'
        if not p.exists(): continue
        content=p.read_bytes();text=content.decode(errors='replace')
        assert not any(re.search(pattern,text) for pattern in patterns),'Secret pattern in '+p.name
        target=raw/(p.name+'.gz')
        target.write_bytes(gzip.compress(content,mtime=0))
        assert gzip.decompress(target.read_bytes())==content
        receipts.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(e)),rawSha256=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(),gzipSha256=digest(target)))
(e/'raw-log-receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(at=now(),secretScanPassed=True,files=receipts),indent=2)+'\n')
with report.open('a') as f:
    f.write('\n\n### Final repair verification — '+now()+'\n\nThe full unfiltered, uncached suite passed with the twelve confirmed extras\nisolated, as did all canonical builds, type checks, lint and source/UI checks.\nActual counts are retained verbatim in `full-suite-pinned-summary.json`.\nThe independent review returned **VERDICT: PASS** with no unresolved actionable\nfindings (`independent-review.txt`). The pre-commit hook separately passed on\nthe original installation from an absent build directory. All existing native\nfinality assertion lines and the dependency compatibility spec are unchanged.\nThe normal hook also refreshed one generated inventory line count for the\nalready-committed remediation register; its actual counting convention is\nrecorded in `generated-inventory-receipt.json`. No new live check was performed.\n\nThe original packages will now be restored and generated runtime removed.\nThe original installation\'s extraneous-package condition is pre-existing and\nis intentionally preserved, not represented as fixed by this source repair.\nPrior failed/interrupted attempts remain recorded with their actual exits.\n')
sources=[report,*[root/name for name in source_hashes],root/'src/main/core/system/provider-quota-service.ts',root/'src/main/core/system/provider-quota-service.spec.ts',root/'package.json',root/'package-lock.json']
def seal(state):
    entries=[dict(checkout='root' if p==report else 'queue',path=str(p),sha256=digest(p)) for p in sources]
    files=[dict(path=str(p.relative_to(e)),sha256=digest(p)) for p in sorted(e.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.name!='verification-seal.json']
    (e/'verification-seal.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(at=now(),state=state,sources=entries,evidence=files,previousSeals='Historical bytes; this seal covers the appended report and post-merge repair'),indent=2)+'\n')
seal('Passing verification and review sealed before owned-runtime cleanup')
isolation=json.loads((e/'dependency-isolation.json').read_text())
assert (root/'node_modules').stat().st_ino==isolation['originalNodeModulesInode']
assert digest(root/'node_modules/.package-lock.json')==isolation['originalInstallLockSha256']
for item in isolation['packages']:
    parked=root/item['parkedPath'];target=root/item['path']
    if parked.exists():
        assert not target.exists() and parked.stat().st_ino==item['inode']
        assert digest(parked/'package.json')==item['manifestSha256']
        os.rename(parked,target)
    assert target.stat().st_ino==item['inode'] and digest(target/'package.json')==item['manifestSha256']
for name,value in isolation['manifestSha256'].items(): assert digest(root/name)==value
restored=dict(at=now(),allTwelveOriginalDirectoriesRestored=True,directoryIdentitiesMatch=True,packageManifestHashesMatch=True,originalNodeModulesInodeMatches=True,originalInstallLockHashMatches=True,repositoryManifestsUnchanged=True,knownOriginalExtraneousConditionPreserved=True)
(e/'dependency-restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps(restored,indent=2)+'\n')
check_env=dict(os.environ,PATH='/Users/suas/.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.1/bin'+os.pathsep+os.environ['PATH'])
tree_check=subprocess.run(['rtk','proxy','npm','ls','--omit=dev','--all','--json'],env=check_env,capture_output=True,text=True)
restored_problems=json.loads(tree_check.stdout).get('problems',[])
original_problems=json.loads((root/'_scratch/post-merge-hook/dependency-tree.json').read_text())['problems']
(e/'restored-dependency-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(at=now(),npmExitCode=tree_check.returncode,problems=restored_problems,sameOriginalProblems=set(restored_problems)==set(original_problems),runtime='Pinned Node 24.22.1',compatibilitySpecUnchanged=True),indent=2)+'\n')
assert set(restored_problems)==set(original_problems),'Restored dependency state differs from the original observed tree'
assert digest(root/'node_modules/.package-lock.json')==isolation['originalInstallLockSha256']

removed=[]
for task_pid in owned_pids:
    for stem,suffix in [('test-run','.log'),('test-results','.json')]:
        p=root/f'_scratch/{stem}.pid-{task_pid}{suffix}'
        if p.exists():p.unlink();removed.append(str(p.relative_to(root)))
for p in [root/'dist',root/'_scratch/post-merge-hook']:
    if p.exists():remove(p);removed.append(str(p.relative_to(root)))
# Preserve unrelated scratch data and the pre-existing dependency/Vite cache.
if (root/'_scratch').exists() and not list((root/'_scratch').iterdir()):(root/'_scratch').rmdir()
assert not (root/'dist').exists() and not (root/'_scratch/post-merge-hook').exists()
assert not command('git','diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
command('git','diff','--check')
status=command('git','status','--short')
(e/'git-final-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(at=now(),status=status,stagedPaths=[],head=command('git','rev-parse','HEAD').strip(),branch=command('git','branch','--show-current').strip(),worktrees=command('git','worktree','list'),branches=command('git','branch','--list'),rootReportStatus=command('git','-C','/Users/suas/work/orchestrat0r/ai-orchestrator','status','--short','--','docs/plans/2026-09-25-mimo-session-resilience_livetest.md')),indent=2)+'\n')
cleanup=dict(at=now(),removed=removed,dependencyPackagesRestored=restored,preExistingViteCachePreserved=True,noAppBrowserDatabaseClusterOrDependencyInstallCreated=True,priorOwnedOrphanFixtureCleanup='owned-fixture-cleanup.json',independentReviewPassed=True,noCommitStashBranchWorktreeCreationOrDocumentRenamePerformed=True)
(e/'cleanup-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(cleanup,indent=2)+'\n')
with report.open('a') as f:
    f.write('\n\n### Repair handoff and cleanup — '+now()+'\n\nOriginal package directories were restored with identical directory identities\nand package-manifest hashes; the original install marker and repository\nmanifests are unchanged. Owned builds, helper scripts and test runtime output\nwere removed after sealing; compressed raw receipts remain as evidence.\nThe pre-existing dependency/Vite cache and unrelated data were preserved.\nNo dev app or browser was launched during this resume, and the earlier orphaned\nfixture was stopped and confirmed gone. The real index is unstaged, the branch\nis unchanged, and no commit, stash, branch/worktree creation or document rename\nwas performed. The coordinator owns closure and integration.\n\nThe source repair and actual hook replay pass. Full-suite verification passes\nwith the twelve extraneous packages isolated; the restored original install\nretains its known dependency-compatibility failure. That environment limitation\nis explicit and is not a claim that the original install now passes the suite.\nThe earlier live-test limits remain unchanged; none of the five live checks\nwas rerun as part of this post-merge repair.\n')
seal('Final post-merge evidence after owned-runtime cleanup and original dependency restoration')
current=json.loads((e/'verification-seal.json').read_text())
assert all(digest(e/item['path'])==item['sha256'] for item in current['evidence'])
assert all(digest(Path(item['path']))==item['sha256'] for item in current['sources'])
print('PASS: source repair verified and independently reviewed; originals restored; owned runtime removed; evidence sealed; nothing committed or staged')
